blocks.text: Buying Building Lots & Redevelopment Land in Tsawwassen, BC

parts.t: Because
Tsawwassen

is a fully built-out peninsula bordered by the Strait of Georgia, Boundary Bay, the U.S. border at Point Roberts, and protected Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR) farmland, vacant residential land is primarily created through infill lot subdivision or by purchasing older 1960s–1970s residences at lot value across
English Bluff
Cliff Drive
Tsawwassen Central
Pebble Hill
, and
Beach Grove

blocks.text: Upland Glacial Till vs. Coastal Floodplain

parts.t: Upland lots in Pebble Hill, Central, Cliff Drive, and English Bluff sit above the coastal floodplain and allow basement excavation, whereas low-lying lots in Beach Grove and Boundary Beach must meet City of Delta Flood Construction Level (FCL) elevation bylaws.

Western bluff parcels on English Bluff Road and Cliff Drive fall under Geotechnical Slope Development Permit Areas, and all Tsawwassen lots are subject to Delta's Urban Forest / Tree Protection Bylaw.
Wide 66- to 100-foot single-family lots in designated residential zones are evaluated for 2-lot subdivision,
infill duplexes
, or Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing (SSMUH) under Delta's Official Community Plan.

blocks.text: Tsawwassen Lots & Vacant Land — Frequently Asked Questions

parts.t: Where do buildable residential lots come from in Tsawwassen?

Nearly all buildable urban sites in Tsawwassen come from subdividing wide 1960s–1970s single-family lots (typically 66 to 100+ feet wide) into two compact lots or tearing down an older rancher/split-level in
English Bluff
Cliff Drive
Tsawwassen Central
Pebble Hill
, or
Beach Grove
Can you dig a basement on a Tsawwassen building lot?

On elevated upland lots in Pebble Hill, Tsawwassen Central, Cliff Drive, and English Bluff, full or daylight basements are permitted subject to soil and storm-sewer depth. On low-lying coastal lots in Beach Grove and Boundary Beach, high water tables and Flood Construction Levels (FCL) dictate slab-on-grade or crawlspace construction.
What geotechnical rules apply to English Bluff and Cliff Drive lots?

Lots along the Strait of Georgia bluff edge fall inside a City of Delta Geotechnical Development Permit Area requiring slope-stability engineering, top-of-bank building setbacks, and controlled storm-water discharge.
How does BC Bill 44 (SSMUH) affect Tsawwassen single-family lots?

Provincial Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing legislation requires municipalities to permit 3 to 4 housing units on qualifying urban single-family lots inside the Urban Containment Boundary, subject to City of Delta zoning, height, lot coverage, servicing, and tree-protection bylaws.
Does 5% GST apply when buying a vacant lot in Tsawwassen?

GST (5%) commonly applies to newly subdivided vacant lots sold by builders or developers, whereas an older lived-in house sold for lot value is generally exempt from GST unless substantially renovated or held as commercial inventory. Verify with a CPA before offering.
How does Delta's Tree Protection Bylaw affect building on a Tsawwassen lot?

Protected trees above regulated trunk diameters require a City of Delta tree-cutting permit, an arborist report, protective fencing during construction, and replacement tree planting or municipal cash-in-lieu fees.
How do urban Tsawwassen lots compare with Tsawwassen ALR farmland?
Urban lots south of 28 Avenue connect to full municipal water and sanitary sewer for residential construction, whereas
Tsawwassen ALR farmland
north and east of the urban boundary is governed by the Agricultural Land Commission.
